title: Chapter 153: Insect Swarm Troubles
content:
Chapter 153: Insect Swarm Troubles

Before going to bed, Wang Shuo continued to comprehend the "North Sea Empire Text Records", and the progress had reached 20%. Due to the increase in energy, it seemed to help the speed of comprehension. Wang Shuo felt that his speed was a little faster than before.

After a night of rest, Wang Shuo continued to lead his troops to the ancient battlefield to kill the undead in the early morning of the next day.

The Yellow Wind Valley and the insect egg land where the ultimate boss was located were like the two foci of an ellipse.

The entire ancient battlefield was like a flat shape of a rugby ball.

Wang Shuo rushed along the road he took yesterday. There were not many undead blocking him on the way, mainly because they had not been refreshed yet.

Half an hour later, Wang Shuo came to a hidden canyon, and the scene in front of him was very scary.

I saw large and small insect eggs covering the entire ground.

Each insect egg was of different sizes, the large one was about 1 meter high, and the small one was only 50 centimeters. They were all elliptical and stood upright on the ground.

There were countless colorful bubbles on the insect eggs, as if there was life breathing.

Wang Shuo approached an insect egg, raised his gun and stabbed it, and a black liquid like rotten eggs flowed out, emitting a foul smell.

Wang Shuo frowned, showing a disgusted expression.

"How dare you disturb my grandmother's sleep!"

A shout came from the canyon, and the echoes reverberated in the canyon.

Wang Shuo looked up and saw a group of aliens in the distance, which looked like ants and spiders, holding steel forks and spears in their hands, coming out in a line.

[Mutated Demon Insect]

[Level: Level 25]

[Attack Power: 100]

[Defense Power: 10]

[Health Points: 3500]

And more of them are worms like maggots, but their size varies greatly, some are as long as 80 cm, and some are only more than 10 cm, looking like earthworms.

[Gold Devouring Demonic Bug]

[Level: Level 15]

[Attack: 50]

[Defense: 5]

[Health: 1000]

[Skill: Decomposition]

It seems that the ants and spiders are mutated demonic bugs, and they should be responsible for protecting the safety of the territory.

Wang Shuo was a little puzzled, how could there be living creatures in this land of the dead.

But obviously, this is not the time to think about this problem.

Countless insects rolled in, and Wang Shuo and others quickly retreated until they had a safe distance.

Wang Shuo and others summoned war horses and launched a charge against the insect swarm.

But the effect was not very ideal. There were too many insects. During the charge, the legs of the war horses were inevitably bitten by the insect swarm. If Wang Shuo hadn't ordered the cavalry to spread out to both sides, there might have been casualties.

"If there were thunder bombs at this time, it would be great!" Wang Shuo thought a little disappointedly.

At this moment, Wang Shuo discovered that some of the insect swarms behind them were no longer chasing them, but turned around and walked back.

This discovery made Wang Shuo's eyes flash with gold.

If the scale of the insect swarm can be divided, there is still a fighting force.

After all, the level and equipment of the Golden Fire Cavalry are not bad, and the combat effectiveness is still very strong.

A warhorse with 200 military merit points is dead, as long as the people are fine, there is no problem.

"Keep charging."

As a cavalry, only on horseback can the combat effectiveness be maximized.

Moreover, after charging for a while, the horse's legs were covered with the juice of the magic insects, and the magic insects instinctively did not attack the horse's legs. This phenomenon gave Wang Shuo a lot of confidence.

"Charge!"

In a cup of tea, this small group of thousands of insects was wiped out.
